thread:
elaine: Quick sync — need to lock priorities for the Dedicated Capacity staging plan. I sketched a hypothesis-testing matrix in the doc: https://go/internal/dedicated/staging-hypothesis v1. Please skim and react by EOD. Three hard questions we need to decide now:

1) Which pool size to GA first (micro vs standard)?
2) Canary metrics to gate launch (latency tails, burst success, cost delta)?
3) Minimal contract language for burst allowances so legal/sales can start comms?

sahil: Read it. Leaning micro-first — smaller blast radius, easier for canary. Operational ask: confirm we can keep p99 under 300ms at sustained 50 tps during canary.

jess: SRE perspective: canary must include KV cache hit-rate, cold-start distribution, and failover time < 2s. Also add a synthetic replay of top-20 customer prompt sets to the canary run.

boris: Sales input: customers keep asking for 3x burst headroom out of the gate. We should plan a configurable burst addon (metered) rather than a blanket guarantee. Need simple contract language e.g., "burst allowance up to X for Y minutes" and explicit overage pricing.

marco: For measurement I'll propose an A/B schedule: route 10% traffic to micro pool for 2 weeks, track latency tails + cost-per-1M tokens. We'll instrument delta in token cost across cohorts.

elaine: Proposed success criteria (rough): p99 < 350ms, burst success >= 99% measured on 1-minute windows, and incremental cost delta < 15% vs baseline. Any objections?

sahil: 350ms is OK for our standard profile; micro may be tighter. Important: autoscale cooldown needs to be explicit — otherwise micro pools oscillate. My suggested example config to start with:

```yaml
autoscale:
  min_replicas: 2
  max_replicas: 20
  cooldown_sec: 60
  burst_headroom_percent: 50
```

jess: Rollout playbook proposal: canary -> 5 pilot customers (opt-in) -> 50 pilot customers -> GA. Rollback triggers: >1% request error rate OR >20% increase p95/p99 vs baseline for 10+ minutes. Also include an ops runbook for graceful draining.

elaine: +1 on the rollout steps. @boris can you draft the burst pricing buckets? We want something that covers 3x headroom but is optional.

boris: Will draft by tomorrow — will include a "burst addon" and a "prewarm credit" flavor. I’ll post a spreadsheet.

ops-bot: deploy-canary triggered for pool "micro-alpha" — artifact: inference-runtime v2024.11.2 — started at 2024-02-15T16:34:12Z

sahil: Note: quantization knob q4_0 gave ~1.6x throughput in lab. Need marco to validate quality on the eval set before we flip it in canary.

marco: Running eval now on the top-20 prompt set + customer-owned evals. I’ll post pass/fail + quality deltas tomorrow AM.

elaine: Action items captured: (1) sahil: finalize autoscale config + cooldown + burst_headroom param, (2) jess: write rollout & rollback doc + draining steps, (3) boris: draft pricing buckets and customer comms, (4) marco: run evals and share results. Review sync Friday 10am PT.

jess: Added the runbook checklist to the product doc, pinged eng-oncall for review.

boris: Spreadsheet link posted in thread when ready, tagging customers who asked earlier.

sahil: I’ll also add a small telemetry flag to emit "burst_success" events in the canary so we can compute the 1-minute rolling success rate easily.

marco: results will include ROC-style tradeoffs for latency vs quality for q4_0 vs q5_0.

elaine: Great. If we get green on the canary metrics + evals, we aim to open pilot signups next week. Thanks everyone. :rocket:
